typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-serif
typography.body: text-base md:text-lg leading-relaxed text-white/90 font-sans font-light

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Center alignment for onboarding/hero prompts. Left alignment for chat flow and paragraphs.

motion_and_interactions.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), and text color shifts to solid gold (#D4AF37).
motion_and_interactions.chat_animation: Framer Motion: initial opacity-0 translate-y-4, animate opacity-100 translate-y-0, transition duration 0.8s ease

components.chat_bubble_ai: bg-transparent border border-[#D4AF37]/20 rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 text-white text-lg font-light leading-relaxed max-w-[85%] md:max-w-[70%]
components.chat_bubble_user: bg-[#111111] text-white border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 self-end max-w-[85%] md:max-w-[70%]
components.input_area: bg-black/80 border-t border-[#D4AF37]/20 p-4 md:p-8 backdrop-blur-2xl
components.input_field: bg-transparent border-none text-white placeholder-white/30 focus:ring-0 text-lg md:text-xl font-light
components.button: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#C29B2E] rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide transition-colors flex items-center justify-center

images.description: AUREN minimalist luxury gold logo on transparent background. Use for splash screen or subtle top nav.
Wavy metallic gold/black surface. Use with very low opacity (10-15%) as a full-page background texture to break up the solid black.
Dark luxury gold subtle wave background for the landing or first screen prompt ('How do you feel today?').

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text has at least 4.5:1 ratio against #000000 background. Gold (#D4AF37) is used for accents and headings only to maintain high readability.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements must include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='chat-input', data-testid='send-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure pure black (#000000) background globally. Do not use generic white/gray Shadcn backgrounds.
Use vanilla HTML/Tailwind over generic Shadcn cards to maintain the premium, border-light design language.
Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' fonts from Google Fonts and configure them in Tailwind.
Create a breathtaking first screen with 'How do you feel today?' centered in large serif type. Transition smoothly into the chat when the user types.
The AI (Thoth) personality is calm, deep, human, and slightly spiritual. Implement mock interactions or an LLM call reflecting this persona and its ability to detect English/French.
Daily reflections can be shown subtly on the initial screen or inside the chat stream as a distinct stylized component.
Use Framer Motion to softly fade in messages, mimicking a deep, thoughtful pause from the AI.
